column1: # 规范词目|词书|中文释义|英文例句|中文例句
bruise|icao4|瘀伤；挫伤|The passenger had a bruise on his arm.|旅客手臂上有一处瘀伤。
in progress|preview|正在进行中|Runway maintenance is in progress.|跑道维护正在进行中。
clear up|icao4|（天气）转晴；（雾）消散|The fog began to clear up after sunrise.|日出后，雾开始消散。
come down|icao4|下降；（云、雾等）降低或笼罩下来|Low cloud may come down over the valley.|低云可能笼罩山谷。
shut down|icao4|关停；关闭（发动机、设备等）|The crew shut down the affected engine.|机组关闭了受影响的发动机。
air-driven|icao5|气动的；由压缩空气驱动的|An air-driven pump supplies pressure to the system.|气动泵为系统提供压力。
booster|icao4|增压装置；助推装置|The booster pump maintains a steady fuel supply.|增压泵保持稳定的燃油供应。
symbol|preview|符号；标志|The pilot identified the symbol on the navigation display.|飞行员识别出了导航显示器上的符号。
bolt|icao4|螺栓|The mechanic replaced a loose bolt.|机务人员更换了一颗松动的螺栓。
blow|preview|吹；刮风|Strong winds continued to blow across the airfield.|大风持续吹过机场。
disperse|icao4|驱散；分散|The birds began to disperse after the noise.|响声过后，鸟群开始散开。
rough|icao4|粗糙的；不平稳的|The crew reported rough running of the engine.|机组报告发动机运转不平稳。
smooth|preview|平稳的；平滑的|The landing was smooth.|这次着陆很平稳。
pool|icao4|积水；水洼|A large pool of water remained on the taxiway.|滑行道上仍有一大片积水。
outbreak|icao4|爆发；突然发生|The crew reported an outbreak of fire in the cabin.|机组报告客舱突然起火。
expire|icao4|到期；失效|The certificate will expire next month.|这份证书下个月到期。
obscure|icao4|遮蔽；使模糊不清|Smoke can obscure the runway lights.|烟雾会遮蔽跑道灯光。
aid|icao4|助航设施；辅助装置；帮助|The crew checked the available navigation aids.|机组检查了可用的助航设施。
stuck|icao4|卡住的；受困的|The aircraft was stuck in mud near the taxiway.|航空器陷在滑行道附近的泥地里。
no longer|preview|不再|The runway is no longer closed.|这条跑道已不再关闭。
prohibit|icao4|禁止|The notice says that smoking is prohibited.|告示上写着禁止吸烟。
DME|||The DME indicated a distance of twenty nautical miles.|DME显示距离为二十海里。
VOR|||The crew tuned the VOR before departure.|离场前，机组调谐了VOR。
gravity|||The crew checked the aircraft's centre of gravity.|机组检查了航空器的重心。
exchanger|||The heat exchanger was inspected after the flight.|飞行结束后，热交换器接受了检查。
cadmium|||Cadmium is used in some aircraft batteries.|某些航空器电池会使用镉。
conductive|||This material is electrically conductive.|这种材料能够导电。
escalate|||The disagreement began to escalate.|分歧开始升级。
inflate|||The life raft began to inflate.|救生筏开始充气。
survival kit|icao4|救生包；生存装备包|The crew checked the survival kit before the flight.|飞行前，机组检查了救生包。
first-aid kit|preview|急救包|A cabin crew member brought the first-aid kit.|一名客舱乘务员拿来了急救包。
polar survival kit|icao5|极地生存装备包|A polar survival kit was loaded for the planned operation.|已为计划中的运行装载极地生存装备包。
